messages:
noah: Quick question 4-day trip to Monaco in June, still keeping my US homebase. will this affect WFH stipend, payroll, or any visa/employer reporting?

mira: short answer: if homebase remains US and payroll stays USD, stipend proration still applies. submit a Temporary Remote Location (TRL) so payroll can tag it.

noah: cool. do we need a visa for work while there? i'm not meeting clients, just remote work from a cafe.

jordi: fyi legal: Monaco is generally tourist-visa territory for short stays for many nationalities. however "working remotely" can be a gray area. for 14 days it's unlikely to trigger employer obligations, but we should confirm based on your passport country. which passport do you have?

noah: US passport.

jordi: ok. I'll check with counsel but expectation: no Monaco payroll registration for 14d. payroll-bot will create a ticket to track.

payroll-bot: Ticket created: #PR-7640  "Monaco 14d: TRL & visa check for noah"  assigned to jordi. ETA 2 business days. :ticket:

ops-qa: small ops note: we do NOT ship peripherals internationally for short trips. you can request a one-time connection stipend (up to $125) as an expense if you need local SIM/hotspot.

noah: thanks. for the TRL, what docs are enough? flight + hotel?

mira: flight + accommodation or a brief travel note is perfect. also put the start/end dates so payroll can pro-rate the stipend.

noah: submitted TRL TL-5234 with dates and booking.

payroll-bot: Update on #PR-7640  TL-5234 received. jordi added note: passport US. status: awaiting legal confirmation.

jordi: legal follow-up: please don't do paid client meetings while overseas; if you meet customers we may need to reclassify activity. also keep receipts for any temporary internet expenses.

noah: understood. any change to benefits/telehealth?

mira: Redwood plans cover emergency care abroad; telehealth from your US provider should work but be mindful of timezones. no change to benefits for <30d.

noah: perfect. last Q: does Monaco's VAT or local tax affect reimbursements/connection stipends?
jordi: connection stipend treated as expense reimbursement, so no local payroll tax expected for a short trip. counsel will confirm.

payroll-bot: #PR-7640 last updated 2153001296: awaiting legal confirmation (jordi).

noah: thanks team 64f will take laptop and rely on my hotspot. appreciate the quick checks.
